==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Giant Shadow Shapeshifters blocked every building, trapping the elves inside their homes. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Giant Shadow Shapeshifters resemble kaiju sized, humanoid beings, who can manipulate their shadowy forms into anything they can imagine.)
They took on spider like forms with elf like faces and chainsaw noses when they noticed my presence and tried to attack me.
I took to the skies, spawned a shotgun made of Lucid Light, and used it to take them down. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
